title: Cardinal DriveSense Scoring Specification — Behaviour Thresholds and Weights
content:
The Cardinal DriveSense driving score is built from five behaviours. For each program the specification sets what counts as each behaviour and how much weight each carries in the score, in percent.

## Part 1 — What counts as each behaviour

| Program | Deceleration counted as a hard brake (mph per second) | Acceleration counted as rapid (mph per second) | Speed above the posted limit counted as speeding (mph) | Late-night driving window (local time) | Handheld phone use while moving lowers the score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 7 | 8 | 15 | 00:00-04:00 | Yes |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 7 | 8 | 15 | 00:00-04:00 | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 7 | 8 | 15 | 00:00-04:00 | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 7 | 8 | 10 | 23:00-05:00 | Yes |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 7 | 8 | 15 | 00:00-04:00 | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 7 | 8 | 15 | 00:00-04:00 | No |

## Part 2 — Weight of each behaviour in the score (percent)

| Program | Hard braking | Rapid acceleration | Speeding | Phone handling | Night driving | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 30 | 15 | 20 | 25 | 10 | 100 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 40 | 20 | 25 | 0 | 15 | 100 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 40 | 20 | 25 | 0 | 15 | 100 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 25 | 10 | 25 | 30 | 10 | 100 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Part 3 — Posting

A running score is posted monthly on every program.

## Notes

- On the four scored programs the five weights total 100. On Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile and Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In every weight is 0.
- Phone handling carries weight only on the two programs where handheld phone use is tracked (Mobile, 25; Teen Coach, 30); on Plug-In and Connected Car its weight is 0.
- Teen Coach sets the speeding figure at 10 mph over the posted limit and uses the wider 23:00-05:00 late-night window; the other programs set it at 15 mph over and use 00:00-04:00.
- Illustration (hypothetical trips): a stretch driven at 12 mph over the posted limit is above the Teen Coach speeding figure (10) and below the 15 used on the other programs; a trip at 01:30 local time falls inside both late-night windows, and a trip at 23:30 only inside the Teen Coach window.
